items.title: 68515_Budd Johnson oral history interview
items.q: had a call to join Eugene Coy and his Happy Black Aces

ctx.x: Anyway, this -- these guys, we played a battle of music up there, and they gave us the proceeds, and we went back home.

All right, now my class was 1928, and I finished high school. And after I finished high school my brother and I -- this was early -- had a call to join Eugene Coy and his Happy Black Aces. They called for us to come to Shawnee, Oklahoma. That's where the Blackfoot Indians are. I used to hang out on these reservations and drink that Choctaw beer with
these Indians, you know, like -- but --
